strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенных: Author's training summary of verified provisions, not a website facsimile
strings.Адрес и установленный вид надзора исполь: The address and established type of supervision must be used together. An authority cannot be selected by one word in its name.
strings.В городе Москве. Адрес совпадает со служ: In the city of Moscow. The address matches the official reference note.
strings.В деле установлены город Москва и федера: The case establishes the city of Moscow and federal-level supervision.
strings.В контрольном эпизоде пришла квитанция о: A delivery receipt arrives in the follow-up episode. It names the recipient for Moscow and Smolensk Regions, although the approved draft selected the authority for the city of Moscow.
strings.В письме я указал московский адрес предп: I gave the enterprise's Moscow address in my letter. They suggested sending it to the directorate for Moscow Region. Is that definitely the right authority? I do not want the letter sent round in circles again.
strings.В справочном пакете Москва указана вмест: The reference package lists Moscow together with Kaluga Region. The address and remit must match the territory and subject matter.
strings.В учебной выписке прямо указано: федерал: The training extract explicitly states: federal state environmental supervision.
strings.В учебном деле нет подтверждения непосре: The training case contains no confirmation of an immediate ongoing danger. The appeal requires the competent authority to examine the claims, not an intern to automatically order an inspection.
strings.В учебном деле подтверждено, что объект: The training case confirms that the facility is in the City of Moscow and subject to federal oversight. Use the reference package to find the territorial authority, not the central office or the directorate for a neighbouring region.
strings.Вы просите справку по телефону или рассм: Are you asking for information by telephone or consideration of your letter?
strings.Выберите допустимые действия и проверьте: Choose permitted actions and check their order. Independent actions may be carried out in different sequences.
strings.Вымышленная выписка: объект расположен в: Fictional extract: the site is in the city of Moscow and subject to federal environmental supervision. These details are established conditions of the scenario, not a real registry extract.
strings.Вымышленный учебный отдел зарегистрирова: A fictional training department registered the appeal. The attached official note states that the site is in the city of Moscow and subject to federal environmental supervision. You prepare referral to the competent authority and a notification. You do not independently order an inspection or establish guilt.
strings.Город Москва и Московская область: The City of Moscow and Moscow Region
strings.Для любого федерального объекта подходит: The Scientific and Technical Council is suitable for any federal-level facility.
strings.Если решение вопросов не относится к ком: If the issues lie outside the recipient's powers, the written appeal is forwarded to the competent body or official and the citizen is notified. An address does not establish authority.
strings.Есть ли сведения об уровне надзора?: Is there information about the level of supervision?
strings.Жалобу нельзя направить на рассмотрение: A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decision, action or inaction is challenged.
strings.Заменить переадресацию звонком по любому: Replace formal referral with a call to any published number
strings.Зафиксировать обращение и приложенные св: Record the appeal and attached information
strings.Заявить гражданину, что ошибка адресата: Tell the citizen that the wrong recipient does not matter.
strings.Какая область входит в название нужного: Which region appears alongside Moscow in the name of the required directorate?
strings.Каких данных достаточно для дальнейшего: Which information is sufficient to continue identifying the territorial authority?
strings.Контакт предназначен только для вопросов: This contact is only for the Scientific and Technical Council's own activities. Find other contacts in the agency's appropriate section.
strings.Контакт-центр для входящей корреспонденц: Contact centre for incoming correspondence and general enquiries: 8 (499) 254-50-72. This is an enquiry line, not submission of a written appeal.

strings.Межрегиональное управление Росприроднадз: Rosprirodnadzor Interregional Administration for Moscow and Smolensk Oblasts

Rosprirodnadzor Interregional Administration for Moscow City and Kaluga Oblast. Moscow reception: 8 (495) 025-23-82, extension 77904. The territory named matters: Moscow City and Moscow Oblast are not interchangeable.
The location is the city of Moscow.
strings.Москва всегда относится к управлению по: Moscow always falls under the directorate for Moscow Region.
strings.Москва и Московская область образуют одн: Moscow and Moscow Region form one territory for every directorate.
strings.На странице совета опубликован телефон 8: The council's page lists 8 (495) 777-31-52, extensions 3934 or 3924. An official website does not make this number suitable for every appeal.
strings.Название Московская в любом органе означ: The word “Moscow” in any authority's name means it has competence over the city of Moscow.
strings.Найдите норму и проверьте её применимост: Find the provision and check applicability. A click count cannot replace information from external sources.
strings.Найдите основание направления обращения: Find the basis for forwarding an appeal to the competent authority.
strings.Наличие письма устанавливает виновность: The existence of a letter establishes the enterprise's guilt.
strings.Направить в научно-технический совет, по: Send it to the Scientific and Technical Council because its telephone number appears on the official website.
strings.Направить в управление по Московской и С: Send it to the directorate for Moscow and Smolensk Regions solely because the name looks similar.
strings.Направление определяется полномочиями; т: Referral is determined by powers; the recipient's territorial competence is checked against the established circumstances.
strings.Начните с предмета обращения. Уточните,: Start with the appeal's subject. Clarify who made the disputed decision and which information is confirmed.
strings.Обращение по 59-ФЗ + оперативная передач: An appeal under 59-FZ plus prompt reporting of danger
strings.Объект находится в городе Москве или в о: Is the site in the city of Moscow or in Moscow Region?
strings.Отделите реквизиты документа от его прим: Separate a document's particulars from its application. In the working source check, attach a specific passage and extract information from it.
strings.Официальность источника необходима для д: An official source is necessary for trusting the contact details, but does not prove that a particular contact is applicable.
strings.Передать жалобу любому сотруднику ведомс: Send the complaint to any employee of the agency without distinguishing their powers.
strings.По условиям установлены адрес в городе М: The scenario establishes an address in the city of Moscow and that the site falls under federal supervision. No acute ongoing threat requiring an emergency response has been established. The level of supervision cannot be inferred from the territory's name alone. A draft referral to the competent authority is needed.
strings.Подготовить направление в управление Рос: Prepare referral to Rosprirodnadzor's directorate for the city of Moscow and Kaluga Region.
strings.Подготовить передачу по установленной ко: Prepare referral under the established remit
strings.Подтверждение передачи должно относиться: Forwarding confirmation must relate to the selected competent recipient; proof of just any dispatch is insufficient.
strings.Подходит управление по городу Москве и К: The directorate for the City of Moscow and Kaluga Region is suitable; its purpose and type of oversight must match the established circumstances.
strings.Положение описывает территориальный орга: The regulation describes the territorial body for Moscow and Smolensk Oblasts. The shared word 'Moscow' does not establish jurisdiction over a facility in Moscow City.
strings.Помощник: «НТС и территориальное управле: Assistant: “The Scientific and Technical Council and the territorial directorate are on the same website, so they are interchangeable recipients.”
strings.Правило исчисления в этом учебном деле:: Calculation rule for this training case: exclude the triggering day. Count all calendar days; if the end falls on a non-working day, move it to the next working day. This profile is specified by the scenario and does not automatically apply to every procedure.
strings.Предложено выбрать управление по Московс: The proposal is to choose the directorate for Moscow and Smolensk Regions merely because its name includes “Moscow”.
strings.Предоставление государственной услуги че: Provision of a public service through a multifunctional centre
strings.При нескольких вопросах, относящихся к р: Where several issues belong to different bodies, copies of the appeal are forwarded to the appropriate recipients. Keep the issues distinguishable.
strings.Приёмная органа власти Москвы: Reception office of a Moscow public authority
strings.Проверить функции подразделения и предел: Check the unit's functions and territorial boundaries, not just its official domain.
strings.Проверьте исходное событие и единицы счё: Check the triggering event and counting units. The reply deadline may differ from the deadline for a specific action.
strings.Рассмотрение письменного обращения. Конт: Consideration of my written appeal. I want to check the contact details so I can choose the correct route.
strings.Рассчитайте крайний день направления зар: Calculate the last day for forwarding the registered written appeal to the competent authority. Do not use this deadline to determine when a supervisory inspection must end.
strings.Сопоставить место объекта, вид надзора и: Compare the site's location, type of supervision and the authority's territory
strings.Сопоставить проект и квитанцию, исправит: Compare the draft and receipt, correct the technical routing within your powers, and clarify the notification.
strings.Сопоставьте новые сведения с предметом д: Compare the new information with the case's subject.
strings.Сохранить подтверждение передачи и выбра: Keep confirmation of forwarding and the selected recipient
strings.Справочный звонок не заменяет формальное: An enquiry call does not replace formal referral.
strings.Справочный номер автоматически заменяет: An information telephone number automatically replaces written referral of an appeal.
strings.Стажёр приёмной не уполномочен самостоят: A reception intern is not empowered to order a supervisory inspection independently.
strings.Считать любую квитанцию подтверждением д: Treat any receipt as confirmation of delivery to the correct authority.
strings.Уведомить заявителя о направлении обраще: Notify the applicant that the appeal has been forwarded
